name: FONBET
note: Official bookmaker of FC Rostov; FONBET wordmark on the chest and sleeve of the 2026-27 home shirt. Also title partner of the KHL (deal khl-fonbet) and of the Russian Cup. Ownership unresolved: The Bell (April 2022) reported that Alexander Udodov became sole owner of Pin-Up.ru and that Fonbet's site then named Pin-Up.ru as its owner, and Stavka.TV (September 2026) repeats that Udodov acquired Fonbet in 2022 - but the same Stavka.TV page, citing the EGRUL register, names AO 'Klir Tsentr' as the founder of licence holder OOO 'Fonkor', and Klir Tsentr's owner is not identified by any opened source (sportclan.ru names a Maxim Kuznetsov but was captcha-walled). Left unrated until the current controlling owner is identified.
